verdict.rationale: OpenTofu claims an ecosystem of 23,600+ modules and centralized module version management, which implies modules can be consumed from a registry. Module authoring is touched on only through `.tofu`/`.tf` precedence for authors targeting both OpenTofu and Terraform. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the public registry and module source/consumption syntax, any evidence of a publishing workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
